headline.interpretation: Months with 10% heavier arrivals (per market-day) have prices about 4% lower, holding month-of-year and year constant. This is an association, not a causal elasticity.

price_taker.note: Elasticity is from the Maharashtra composite; applying it to one APMC's tonnage is an order-of-magnitude check.

forecast.selection_rule: lowest Apr-Dec MAPE on validation seasons 2019-2022; scored on 2023-2024

H2_B_vs_A.note: not testable: every season identical (the B plan never stores, so it equals harvest sale)

C_vs_A.note: too few seasons for a meaningful test; numbers reported descriptively

H3_C_vs_B.note: too few seasons for a meaningful test; numbers reported descriptively

H2_B_vs_A.note: not testable: every season identical (the B plan never stores, so it equals harvest sale)

marginal_values.note: Scenario A: selling all at harvest fixes every decision (C = 0, L = Q), so there are no meaningful shadow prices.
